slot.intent: The chairman told the court that they never saw the money.

concept: The quote's own opening mark arrives large and settles into the margin as the quotation builds; a highlighter sweeps the claim as it ends, and a rule drawn off the margin names who said it.
storyboard: 0.0 s, on "We": a large grey opening mark fades in at the left margin and We builds beside it in heavy sentence case, grey settling to off white
0.6 s: the mark settles slowly into the margin from the first frame, shrinking from its corner to a hanging mark well above the capitals, done by 1.3 s; it never crosses the words
2.8 s, on "money,": the quotation closes with a grey closing mark and, as the last word lands, a flat red highlighter sweeps behind the money in one stroke
3.2 s: a hairline rule draws down out of the mark's foot and turns toward where the name will be, in place as THE is spoken at 3.5 s
4.2 s, on "chairman": the attribution builds word by word in tracked caps, THE CHAIRMAN TOLD THE COURT, as We never saw steps back to mid grey
6.5 s: full hold to the end, the claim bright on red, the mark and its rule framing the margin; the camera never moves

leansOn.why: Words build grey to off white as spoken, and one highlighter sweep runs behind the key words as the last word lands, in a single motion.
